title: 第13章 深夜报信第14章 鱼呢鱼去哪儿了
content_zh:
;;
后半夜，月明星稀。
赵玉兰家房门悄无声息的打开，从里面蹑手蹑脚走出来一人。
她小心翼翼的打着手电，出了村口就直奔鱼塘这边。
瓜棚内。
李向东正盘腿坐着修炼《长生经》，忽然感觉到有人靠近。
立即将身体内运行一个大周天的气停下来，抱着大黄仰面一躺。
没过多久，那人径直来到瓜棚前，拿着手电往里面一照，雪白光柱直直的照射在李向东脸上。
“谁？”
李向东假装刚睡醒，很是惊讶的伸手拦住光柱。
“是我。”
赵玉兰关掉手电筒，露出了真容。
皎洁月光下，她身上仅穿着一件材质柔软的碎花睡衣裙。
领口有些松散，隐约能看到一些山岳轮廓。
李向东见到她的出现，目光有所触及，很是兴奋的坐起来。
“你怎么来了？”
“难道李宏财真的去了二狗家？”
赵玉兰被猜出来这里的原因，伸手拨弄发丝俏脸一红。
“忙我已经帮了，消息也帮你带到了，我可以回去了吧。”
李向东怔怔盯着她红透的脸。

她完全可以打个电话就行，却偏偏要亲自来这一趟。
戏谑道：
“玉兰姐，你想不想去现场看看过程？”
赵玉兰张口一啐，扭头怒骂：
“呸，盖上被子还不都是一样，有什么区别。”
李向东呵呵一笑：
“区别大了，就他们俩弄的那些状况，你恐怕很少见到。”
赵玉兰被勾起兴趣，单手下意识的抱住腰肢，动人曲线更加明显。
侧着头一脸柔媚反问道：
“你怎么知道，难道你在哪儿见过？”
李向东双眼紧盯着她，情绪有些激动。
见她对这个话题感兴趣，便绘声绘色的把那天所见所闻讲给她听。
“你还记得上坟那天吗，他们俩一大早就在玉米地里辛勤劳作......”
赵玉兰从不知道这些东西，被说得脸颊红透捂住嘴巴。

In the second half of the night, the moon and stars were sparse.
The door of Zhao Yulan's house opened quietly, and a person tiptoed out.
She carefully turned on her flashlight and walked straight to the fish pond after exiting the village.
Inside the melon shed.
Li Xiangdong was sitting cross-legged practicing the "Eternal Life Sutra" when he suddenly felt someone approaching.
Immediately stop the Qi that circulates in the body for a large amount of time, and lie down on your back holding the rhubarb.
Not long after, the man came straight to the melon shed and took a flashlight to shine inside. The snow-white beam of light shone directly on Li Xiangdong's face.
"Who?"
Li Xiangdong pretended to have just woken up, and stretched out his hand to block the light beam in surprise.
"It's me."
Zhao Yulan turned off the flashlight and revealed her true appearance.
Under the bright moonlight, she was only wearing a floral pajama dress made of soft material.
The neckline is a little loose, and some mountain outlines can be vaguely seen.
When Li Xiangdong saw her appearance, his eyes touched her and he sat up excitedly.
"Why are you here?"
"Did Li Hongcai really go to Ergou's house?"
When Zhao Yulan guessed the reason, she reached out to ruffle her hair and blushed.
"I've already helped you, and I've brought you the news. I can go back."
Li Xiangdong stared at her red face.
She could have just made a phone call, but she had to come in person.
Jokingly said:
"Sister Yulan, do you want to go there and see the process?"
Zhao Yulan spat, turned her head and cursed angrily:
"Bah, it's not all the same when covered with a quilt, what's the difference?"
Li Xiangdong laughed:
"The difference is huge. I'm afraid you rarely see the situations they two caused."
Zhao Yulan's interest was aroused, and she subconsciously hugged her waist with one hand, making her beautiful curves more obvious.
He tilted his head and asked with a soft face:
"How do you know? Have you seen it somewhere?"
Li Xiangdong stared at her closely, feeling a little excited.
Seeing that she was interested in this topic, he vividly told her what he had seen and heard that day.
"Do you still remember the day they visited the grave? They were working hard in the cornfield early in the morning..."
Zhao Yulan had never known these things before, her cheeks turned red and she covered her mouth when she was told.
